visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a vibrant red sleeveless dress and large white bow earrings, stands on an outdoor rooftop. She holds a silver flute to her lips, her fingers poised on the keys. A yellow text box with black text and Chinese characters appears at the bottom, while a musical score is overlayed at the top. The background features a grey metal railing and blurred city buildings under bright, natural daylight. (2) As the performance continues, the camera cuts to a slightly different medium-shot angle of the woman playing. Her expression is focused, with her eyes occasionally looking towards the camera. The sheet music overlay at the top changes to reflect the progression of the piece. The lighting remains consistent, casting soft shadows on her face and the red fabric of her dress. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up shot focusing on the woman's hands as they manipulate the silver flute's keys with precision. The texture of the metal flute and the rhythmic movement of the keys are clearly visible. The background is heavily blurred, creating a shallow depth of field that highlights the physical interaction between the performer and the instrument. (4) A transition effect blends the previous shot into a medium shot of the woman playing again. New text appears in a white font without a background box, providing context about the music. She continues her performance with fluid body movements, swaying slightly to the rhythm. The outdoor urban environment provides a spacious context for the performance. (5) The video cuts back to the initial framing with the yellow text box updated with new text content. The woman maintains her posture, blowing into the flute with controlled breath. The sheet music continues to scroll at the top of the frame. The bright, natural light emphasizes the saturation of her red dress against the muted grey background. (6) In the final phase, the woman lowers the flute and smiles warmly at the camera. A final text overlay appears with a call to action. The background buildings and railing are still visible, maintaining the rooftop setting. The video ends on this social engagement shot, with her face centered and clearly visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: What if I played a Ravel flute excerpt in 'Die with a Smile'? 如果我把拉威爾的長笛片段融合進《Die with a Smile》呢？ (2) [Slogan]: This melody comes from Maurice Ravel's (1875-1937) famous orchestral work Daphnis et Chloé. (3) [Slogan]: I sped it up a bit to fit the tempo of Die with a Smile. (4) [Slogan]: Kind of a perfect match, don't you think? (5) [Slogan]: Did you enjoy it? Tell me what you think in the comments!
